tools.name: directo_get_api_description
tools.description: Show which resources and filter names this Directo API key can read (GET /v1/openapi.json). Call it first to learn the field names for the other tools.

tools.name: directo_list_customers
tools.description: List customer cards (code, name, country, city, VAT number, payment terms, credit limit, contacts). Filter by code, name, country, closed or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: directo_list_items
tools.description: List item cards (code, name, class, unit, price, supplier, barcode, weight) with stock quantity by warehouse. Filter by code, name, class, status, warehouse, country, quantity or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/items.

tools.name: directo_list_orders
tools.description: List sales orders with their lines (header fields plus row_* line fields). Filter by number, date, status, customer_code, row_item, warehouse, closed or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: directo_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with their lines (header fields plus row_* line fields). Filter by number, date, customer_code, row_item, row_quantity or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/invoices.

tools.name: directo_list_stock_levels
tools.description: List stock quantities per item and warehouse. Filter by code, warehouse, quantity or ts. Directo API: GET /v1/stocklevels.

tools.name: directo_list_records
tools.description: Read any other enabled resource, for example suppliers, purchase_invoices, receipts (incoming payments), projects, accounts or transactions. Pass the resource name and optional filters as field name → value pairs; get the field names from directo_get_api_description. Directo API: GET /v1/{resource}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "directo_list_customers" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
